pain_point: Workload pressure often becomes visible only once deadlines are already at risk.
proposed_action: Create a fortnightly workload pulse check that asks what is rising what can move and what needs escalation.

pain_point: Cross-team requests arrive through multiple channels and are hard to compare.
proposed_action: Use one simple intake template for cross-team requests including urgency owner and trade-off needed.

pain_point: Project work and BAU work compete but the trade-off is not always explicit.
proposed_action: Add a monthly stop pause continue review for work that exceeds capacity.

pain_point: People are unsure what happens after they raise a workload concern.
proposed_action: Publish a light escalation pathway with response times decision points and feedback loops.

pain_point: Staff can worry that naming workload pressure will be read as not coping.
proposed_action: Give managers prompts for neutral workload conversations that focus on system pressure and trade-offs.

pain_point: Some tasks bounce between teams because ownership is unclear.
proposed_action: Create a shared responsibility map for repeat request types and escalation points.

pain_point: Change initiatives add work but the local workload impact is not always reviewed.
proposed_action: Add workload impact checks to local change planning and review after launch.
